_what: The two facts about each code repository that `.agent-org/project.json` does not hold, keyed by `repo` (#3123, ADR 0039 item 5). `.agent-org/project.json`'s `code` array is THE list of code repositories and the `agent-org` tool owns its schema, so this file adds a default branch and a required check name beside it and never a second list: `layer-repository-protection.test.ts` fails when a listed repository has no entry here.
_read: `branch-protection.test.ts` takes its repository and branch from here (`A11Y_PROTECTION_REPO=<owner/name>`, else the primary's), `layer-repository-protection.test.ts` reads every entry, and `nightly.yml` runs the read once per listed repository. A repository that is declared but unreadable is CANNOT_TELL and never a pass. The order a new one is created in is `docs/new-code-repository.md`.
_requiredCheck: `gate` on both: `ci.yml`'s single job that every path-scoped result rolls up into (a required check with no run blocks a merge for ever), and the context `a11ign/agent-org`'s own ruleset requires.
_publishes: Whether the repository publishes to the npm registry (#3705). It decides what the `npm-publish` environment cell reads: a publisher must carry the environment, restricted to its default branch (`docs/new-code-repository.md`), and a repository that does not publish must carry none. `agent-org`, `control` and `lab` release a tag and a GitHub Release only, with no registry token by design (each `release.yml` says so, read 2026-10-05).
_releaseShape: Not a field of an entry: every repository's release workflow is `.github/workflows/release.yml` on its `defaultBranch`, and `layer-repository-protection.test.ts`'s `release-shape` cell parses it (#3718). A per-merge workflow reads OK and a version-pull-request workflow DRIFT; the rule is on `docs/new-code-repository.md`, under *The table*.
_standardColumns: Not fields of an entry either (#3962): `test-runner`, `release-standard`, `typecheck` and `build` are read from each repository's default branch, and the only entry field they use is `publishes` (a publisher must build with Rslib) and `requiredCheck` (the job `tsc --noEmit` must run in or be waited for by). The rule is on `docs/new-code-repository.md`, under *The standard columns*.
